title: Stop Message
description: Stops an in-flight message generation in a chat. Useful for cancelling a streaming response that is still being generated.
content:
# Stop Message

## Usage

<CodeVariant
language="TypeScript"
title="TypeScript Example"
code={`import  from 'v0-sdk'

const result = await v0.chats.stopMessage({
chatId: 'chat_abc123',
messageId: 'msg_xyz789',
})

console.log(result)`}
/>

<CodeVariant
language="cURL"
title="cURL Example"
code={`curl -X POST https://api.v0.dev/chats//messages//stop \
-H "Authorization: Bearer $V0_API_KEY" \
-H "Content-Type: application/json"`}
/>

## API Signature

### Request

#### Path Parameters

<APISignature
title=""
parameters={[
{
"name": "chatId",
"type": "string",
"required": true,
"description": "The unique identifier of the chat containing the message to stop. Provided as a path parameter."
},
{
"name": "messageId",
"type": "string",
"required": true,
"description": "The identifier of the specific message to stop. Provided as a path parameter."
}
]}
/>

### Response

<APISignature
title=""
parameters={[
{
"name": "success",
"type": "true",
"required": true,
"description": "Indicates that the stop signal was sent successfully.",
"deprecated": false
}
]}
/>

---
